personal.preferred_title: Application Support / IT Applications Analyst | SQL, RCA, Testing & Financial Systems

summary: Senior application support, data analysis, and production reliability professional with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across SQL, financial-services systems, application support, production troubleshooting, root cause analysis, test planning, regression validation, data flow analysis, Excel/reporting workflows, Agile/Scrum collaboration, documentation, and business-user communication. Strong background partnering with technical and business teams to investigate issues, validate fixes, document requirements, support releases, improve operational processes, and maintain trusted reporting/data outputs. Best aligned to IT Applications Analyst and Application Support roles requiring SQL queries, financial software/process support, RCA, test scripts, regression testing, data maintenance, stakeholder demos, training materials, and customer-focused support.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Supported business and technical stakeholders by investigating production reporting issues, data discrepancies, failed outputs, missing or late feeds, and downstream dashboard problems in a regulated financial-services environment.
Wrote SQL queries and Python/Pandas workflows to analyze complex operational datasets, validate data accuracy, identify trends, reconcile outputs, and support root cause analysis.

Built and maintained data pipelines ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints and transforming raw operational data into curated reporting, analytics, forecasting, and validation datasets.
Partnered with infrastructure, application, analytics, engineering, and business teams to clarify requirements, explain data behavior, document issues, and recommend practical solutions.
Developed validation checks, reconciliation steps, test comparisons, and regression-style output reviews to confirm that reporting changes and pipeline fixes produced expected results.
Created runbooks, metric definitions, data flow notes, validation checkpoints, support procedures, and knowledge-sharing documentation to improve repeatability and application support handoff.
Used Excel-style analysis, SQL, Python, dashboards, and reporting outputs to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Supported Agile-style delivery by breaking work into trackable tasks, reviewing outputs with stakeholders, documenting acceptance criteria, and improving reporting processes over time.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Provided application performance and reporting support for Brand.com and critical hospitality systems using Dynatrace AppMon and Gomez Synthetic Monitoring data.
Analyzed complex monitoring datasets to identify trends, defects, user-impacting symptoms, and performance improvement opportunities.
Created dashboards and reporting views that translated raw monitoring data into actionable insights for business and engineering stakeholders.
Collaborated with application and infrastructure teams to validate findings, troubleshoot issues, and support release-readiness decisions.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Supported a large financial-services monitoring environment with 50+ Enterprise Managers and 4,000–6,000 instrumented agents, helping application, middleware, infrastructure, and operations teams resolve production issues.
Built Perl and KornShell automation for extracting, validating, transforming, and distributing performance data, replacing manual reporting processes with repeatable workflows.
Designed dashboards, alert rules, SLA thresholds, reporting standards, and technical documentation used by support and engineering teams.
Provided troubleshooting guidance, onboarding support, training materials, and knowledge sharing to improve application support practices.

experience.title: Performance Test Engineer
bullets: Developed and executed performance test plans for enterprise telecom applications, including baseline comparisons, regression review, and release-readiness analysis.
Analyzed application behavior under load to identify throughput limits, SQL/JDBC bottlenecks, CPU, memory, thread, and garbage-collection issues.
Documented test results, expected behavior, defects, risks, and remediation recommendations for engineering and release teams.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led migration validation for a high-throughput shopping engine moving from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC cluster, preserving transaction performance and data integrity.
Built validation and regression testing utilities to verify correctness across millions of migrated transaction records.
Optimized SQL and Oracle access patterns for high-volume workloads while reducing physical hardware footprint by 95%.
Supported phased cutover, troubleshooting, documentation, and production-readiness activities for a mission-critical enterprise migration.

experience.title: Architect / Developer (IRS CADE Project)
bullets: Designed UML class and sequence diagrams and developed modules for IRS CADE mainframe modernization.
Built CICS, MQ Series, XML messaging interfaces, and DB2-backed components in a government modernization environment.
Supported technical design documentation, integration patterns, and structured data exchange across modernization components.

experience.title: Developer / Support Engineer (Billing, Interfaces, CSM/PRMS)
bullets: Developed and supported billing, customer-management, and financial-style operational interfaces using Oracle, PL/SQL, C/C++, Pro*C, SQL scripts, XML, and messaging patterns.
Built automation scripts in KornShell/ksh, Perl, Awk, Syncsort, and SQL to support data extraction, transformation, reporting, deployments, and production housekeeping.
Provided production support, defect investigation, data maintenance, issue escalation, and troubleshooting for telecom billing and customer-management applications.
Improved database performance by 10x through SQL, sequence, and process optimization while reducing memory usage by 75%.
